scope: Theorem 8.1 (Transfer through small supports) of the manuscript “Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting” (preprints/Witnessed-symmetric-choice-is-strictly-stronger-than-choiceless-polynomial-time-with-counting-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 243 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d648a0d83b5f41b1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B0, B1 be nonempty finite structures in the same finite relational vocabulary of arity at most two, and let Ki ≤ Aut(Bi) for i = 0, 1. Let s, m, M be positive integers with max{4, m + 1}s ≤ M. Suppose that: 1. B0 and B1 satisfy the same CM sentences; 2. in each Bi, any two tuples of length at most max{2, m}s having the same CM type belong to the same Ki-orbit. Then Ds(B0, K0) and Ds(B1, K1) satisfy the same Cm sentences in membership, atomhood, and the base relations.
